solution_summary: Observe.AI developed and open-sourced the One Load Audit Framework on AWS to optimize machine learning model costs, boost developer efficiency, and scale to meet data growth. Observe.AI uses conversation intelligence to uncover insights from live and post-customer interactions, helping companies increase contact center agent performance. The company developed and open-sourced the One Load Audit Framework (OLAF), which integrates with Amazon SageMaker to automatically find bottlenecks and performance problems in machine learning services. Using OLAF to load-test Amazon SageMaker instances, Observe.AI reduced machine learning costs by over 50 percent, lowered development time from one week to hours, and facilitated on-demand scaling to support a tenfold growth in data load size. Source data enters the Observe.AI workflow through its application services, processed with Amazon SageMaker, coordinated by Amazon SNS, Amazon SQS.
